text: dsh-plugin-llmtr 是面向 DSH 的 LLMTR 模型提供商插件，通过 ctx.llm 注册 llmtr 路由并提供模型发现。它可从网关读取并筛选聊天模型目录，也允许固定模型列表或按模型覆盖信息；聊天请求经 OpenAI 兼容接口以流式方式返回。适合希望在 DSH 会话中选择 LLMTR 或其网关模型的用户。需要 LLMTR_API_KEY；模型目录从 llmtr.com 获取，聊天请求也发送至配置的网关。

dsh-plugin-llmtr adds LLMTR as a DSH model provider. It lists gateway chat models and sends selected chat requests through an OpenAI-compatible streaming endpoint. An LLMTR_API_KEY is needed; requests go to the configured gateway.
想在 DSH 里选择 LLMTR 网关提供的聊天模型。
I want DSH to use chat models through an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
希望模型选择器能从网关目录列出可用的聊天模型。
dsh-plugin-llmtr 的功能「网关模型发现」：从 LLMTR 的模型目录获取模型，并按 chat 或 turkey-hosted 范围筛选后提供给 DSH 选择器；也可通过配置固定模型列表。
dsh-plugin-llmtr 的功能「流式模型调用」：DSH 选择 llmtr 提供商和模型后，插件把聊天请求发送到配置的 /chat/completions 接口，并将响应作为流交给 DSH。
dsh-plugin-llmtr 使用前须知：聊天请求携带 LLMTR API key 并发送到配置的网关；模型目录也从该网关读取。（src/adapter.ts:373-391；src/catalog.ts:139-149）

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · dsh-plugin-llmtr：English | [Türkçe](README.tr.md)

An [LLMTR](https://llmtr.com) provider route for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

LLMTR is an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway. One API key reaches 170+ chat models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Qwen, Mistral, xAI and others — plus the models LLMTR runs on its own infrastructure in Türkiye, for deployments that need their prompts to stay in-country.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · dsh-plugin-llmtr：This plugin registers those models as the `llmtr` provider route on `ctx.llm`, so they appear in the harness model picker and can be selected per session, per agent, and per subagent like any other route.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-llmtr
```

The package ships a bundle patch, so `plugin add` inserts the row for you. Then open **Settings → Models**, find the **LLMTR** card, paste a key from [llmtr.com](https://llmtr.com), and save. The key is stored in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`; settings retain only its reference.

The model picker fills itself from the gateway's live listing — nothing to type, and models LLMTR adds later appear without an upgrade.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Without the plugin CLI：Add the row to your own `cordis.yml` or `--patch` overlay:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: llm-llmtr
      name: dsh-plugin-llmtr
```

and export the key instead of storing it:

```sh
export LLMTR_API_KEY=llmtr-...
```

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Model ids：Model ids are the gateway's own, `owner/model`, and are sent verbatim:

```
openai/gpt-5.4          anthropic/claude-...      google/gemini-3.7-flash
qwen/qwen3-8-...        mistral/...               deepseek/deepseek-v4-...
llmtr/muse-glimmer-30b-tr   llmtr/trendyol-asure-12b   llmtr/gemma-4
```

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Model ids：Ids starting with `llmtr/` are the ones LLMTR hosts in Türkiye; the picker labels them "Hosted in Türkiye on LLMTR infrastructure". Everything else is routed to its upstream provider and processed under that provider's own terms — the plugin does not claim otherwise for them.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Data residency：To offer only the in-country models, narrow the catalog scope:

```yaml
llm-llmtr:
  catalogScope: turkey-hosted
```

The picker then lists nothing else, so a session cannot be started on a model whose prompts leave the country.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Configuration：Every field is optional and lives in the `llm-llmtr` section of `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (or in the plugin row's `config`). Changes reach the next request without a restart; an in-flight stream keeps the values it started with.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Configuration：| Field | Default | What it decides |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `LLMTR_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved per request |
| `baseURL` | `https://llmtr.com/v1` | Endpoint; `$LLMTR_BASE_URL` from a trusted launch layer overrides the default |
| `headers` | `{}` | Extra request headers; authentication and attribution names always win |
| `catalogScope` | `chat` | `chat`, `turkey-hosted`, or `all` |
| `catalogTtlMs` | `900000` | How long a fetched listing is reused |
| `models` | `[]` | A pinned list; non-empty replaces the live listing entirely |
| `modelOverrides` | `{}` | Per-model corrections applied over the live listing |
| `reasoningEfforts` | `[]` | Effort ids the gateway accepts for your models |
| `maxTokens` | `32768` | Default per-request output cap |
| `defaultContextWindow` | `131072` | Capacity assumed for a model you have not sized |
| `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Idle ceiling while a stream read is outstanding |
| `retryPolicy` | harness default | Provider-owned retry policy |

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Context windows：The LLMTR listing publishes ids and operations, not capacities, so every model is sized at `defaultContextWindow` until you say otherwise. Correct the ones you actually use:

```yaml
llm-llmtr:
  modelOverrides:
    openai/gpt-5.4:
      contextWindow: 400000

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Reasoning effort：Reasoning **output** works out of the box: the adapter reads both `reasoning_content` and `reasoning` deltas, so a reasoning model's thinking shows up in the transcript with no configuration.

Selecting an effort **level** is opt-in, because the gateway fans requests out to upstreams that reject `reasoning_effort` on non-reasoning models. Declare what your models accept and the harness offers exactly those:

```yaml
llm-llmtr:
  reasoningEfforts: [low, medium, high]
```

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Reasoning effort：With the list empty, no selector is shown and nothing reaches the wire. A request carrying an undeclared effort is refused by name rather than silently dropped.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Pinning a model list：A deployment that must fix exactly which models its users can reach replaces the listing instead of filtering it:

```yaml
llm-llmtr:
  models:
    - id: llmtr/muse-glimmer-30b-tr
      name: Muse Glimmer 30B

With `models` non-empty the gateway listing is never fetched.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Scope：- **Chat completions only.** Requests go to `/v1/chat/completions` with streaming and usage reporting on. LLMTR's embeddings, image, video, rerank, and realtime models are listed by `catalogScope: all` but cannot be routed by this adapter, which is why `chat` is the default.
- **Text in, text out.** Image content is refused before it is sent, naming the model, rather than being flattened away.
- **One attempt per call.** Retries belong to the harness retry policy, so a failure is visible once rather than hidden inside the adapter.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Privacy：The plugin sends the harness's standard `User-Agent`, an `x-llmtr-client` header naming this package and version, and your API key. No session id, prompt text, file path, or user identifier is added to any header.

dsh-plugin-llmtr README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test          # 80 unit tests, no network and no key required
npm run typecheck
npm run build

`tests/mock-server.ts` stands in for the gateway, so the suite runs offline.
